name: AdvaCare Pharma USA
old_description: Over the past two decades, AdvaCare Pharma has developed a reputation as a reliable manufacturer of Medical Devices and healthcare products. Our extensive product portfolio, comprising 500+ class I and II medical devices, spans 5 product divisions including AccuPoint™ Injection Instruments, AccuQuik™ Diagnostic Detection Devices, StaySafe™ Medical Disposables, StayGuard™ Skin & Wound Care and StayDry™ Incontinence & Urology Products. AdvaCare Pharma's dedication to manufacturing high-quality yet cost-effective medical devices is rooted in our focus on delivering tailored solutions to meet the diverse needs of every market.
about:
AdvaCare Pharma USA was founded in 2005 in Cheyenne, Wyoming, as an American-managed pharmaceutical and healthcare company. The business began with a focus on delivering high-quality, affordable medical products to distributors worldwide.

The company manufactures and distributes more than 4,000 branded pharmaceuticals, medical devices, dietary supplements, and veterinary products across 65-plus markets. Production takes place at facilities in China, India, and the United States, all operating under GMP rules and ISO and CE certifications. The portfolio includes over 500 Class I and II medical devices organized into five divisions, 500-plus pharmaceuticals in 13 dosage forms, 150-plus supplements, and 250-plus veterinary items.

AdvaCare serves distributors, hospitals, pharmacies, NGOs, and government institutions globally, with a noted presence in West Africa, Asia, Latin America, the Middle East, and Europe. Customers range from regional distributors in emerging markets to institutional buyers in developed economies.

The company was founded on the premise of providing best value to distributors through quality, affordability, and market-specific solutions. Its vested supplier-distributor model yields an 88% retention rate, supported by regulatory affairs expertise that has registered thousands of products worldwide, flexible production lines that adapt specifications to local requirements, and marketing and logistics support provided at no extra cost.
